findings.evidence: TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/ClassicalGroups/Diagonal.lean:73 `theorem isUnit_apply_of_isDiag {g : GL ι k} (hg : (g : Matrix ι ι k).IsDiag) (i : ι) : IsUnit ((g : Matrix ι ι k) i i)`; :86 `apply_eq_zero_of_commute_diagonal`; :96 `isDiag_of_commute_diagonal {t : ι → k} (ht : Function.Injective t) {g} (hg : Commute (Matrix.diagonal t) g) : g.IsDiag`; TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/ClassicalGroups/Torus.lean:90 `mem_diagonalTorus_iff : g ∈ diagonalTorus k n ↔ (g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) k).IsDiag`.
findings.fix: Prove it as: forward, rewrite `diagGL_coe` and apply `isDiag_of_commute_diagonal` (or `apply_eq_zero_of_commute_diagonal` at (0,1) and (1,0)) then `mem_diagonalTorus_iff.mpr`; backward, `Subgroup.centralizer_le` on `{diagGL t} ⊆ diagonalTorus` composed with `Subgroup.le_centralizer` for the commutative `diagonalTorus`. This needs no `commute_finTwo_iff` and generalizes to any `n` with injective `t`. These lemmas currently sit under `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/ClassicalGroups/`; move the matrix-level ones (`isUnit_apply_of_isDiag`, `apply_eq_zero_of_commute_diagonal`, `isDiag_of_commute_diagonal`, `diagonalTorus` and its API) down to `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Diagonal.lean` and import that.

summary: The commutant lemma `commute_finTwo_iff` and the elliptic half are genuinely new (Mathlib has no single-matrix commutant result), but the split half re-derives TauCeti's existing diagonal-matrix API: `TauCeti.isDiag_of_commute_diagonal`, `TauCeti.isUnit_apply_of_isDiag`, `TauCeti.mem_diagonalTorus_iff`, `TauCeti.diagonalTorus` and `TauCeti.diagonalTorusEquiv` are all reimplemented or re-spelled. The order of `GL₂(𝔽_q)` is now computed in three places.
